description: List clock changes for one city. Defaults to the next year. Each change includes the local time and the ISO week and US week of that local date. The range can be at most 366 days. dst_changes still calls this tool.

city.description: City name or a city id from search_cities. Spelling and accents are flexible. When several cities share a name, the best match from the site search is used and the others come back in alternatives.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 365 days later.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_dst_changes

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

weeks.description: ISO week (Monday start; week 1 contains the year's first Thursday) and US week (Sunday start; 1 January is week 1 of that calendar year).

title: Daylight-saving changes
